dslRule:
<!id: stream.sorted.findFirst.to.min>
<!description: Replace Stream.sorted(Comparator).findFirst() with Stream.min(Comparator) for conciseness and efficiency, as they are semantically equivalent for finding the minimum element.>
<!severity: HINT>
java.util.Arrays.stream($array$).sorted($comparator$).findFirst()
=>
java.util.Arrays.stream($array$).min($comparator$)
;;
